content.comment_body: I am using a [product_name] controller with an extension input/output module [product_name]. The indicator diode on the module is green, but during programming, I cannot see the additional outputs provided by the extension module. Can anyone clarify what might be causing this issue?

Typically, outputs Q1 to Q16 (or up to Q20) are available even without using the expansion module. It appears you have a recent [product_name] device (with [article_no]) and have likely chosen this [article_no] in your hardware configuration. If your [product_name] is the newest version, you should select [product_name] version FS4. This selection is available only when using [product_name] programming software version V8.1 or later.

analysis.insight_summary: The user cannot access extension module outputs in the programming software, despite the hardware showing normal operation. Responses indicate the root cause is related to proper hardware selection and compatibility with the programming software version, emphasizing the need to select the correct hardware profile and use a compatible software release.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that once the extension module is properly connected and powered, the additional outputs will be automatically available for selection within the programming interface.
